rule.label: faculty of understanding
rule.definition: Understanding as an intellectual faculty engaged in analysis, distinctions and thought, locally contrasted with other faculties such as creative imagination or synthesizing reason.
rule.rule: Prefer understanding where faculty contrasts matter. In im Verstande des Redenden the possessor identifies the speaker’s faculty; it is not the idiom in the sense.
rule.caution: Different activities of this faculty are retained as contextual uses, not counted as new lexical senses. The separate sense-of-expression idiom requires its own construction and context.

rule.label: words as material of discourse
rule.definition: Words as the material out of which discourse is formed.
rule.rule: Distinct from sound as resistant material and from unnecessary conceptual matter.

rule.label: Base word identified relatively within an analysis whose access to original beginnings is limited
rule.definition: Base word identified relatively within an analysis whose access to original beginnings is limited.
rule.rule: Not automatically a historical first word.

rule.label: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift
rule.definition: Inherited audible word forms which can remain relatively stable while their meanings shift.
rule.rule: Not only the exact wording of a written passage.

rule.label: What a word presents as its object, whether physically identifiable or formed by mind
rule.definition: What a word presents as its object, whether physically identifiable or formed by mind.
rule.rule: Not restricted to a physical referent.

rule.label: The individual representation of an object occasioned by a word, distinguished from the object itself
rule.definition: The individual representation of an object occasioned by a word, distinguished from the object itself.
rule.rule: Do not silently translate as concept or physical image in all cases.

rule.label: view or standpoint of the world
rule.definition: A view/standpoint of the world belonging to an individual and further shaped and intensified through language; a language’s connected presentation can thus have its own distinctive world-view.
rule.rule: Preserve the individual standpoint already possible independently of language in§39 and the additional contribution made by language. Keep individual and language bearers explicit.
rule.caution: The uses do not imply identical beliefs or one ideology for all speakers. The later Weltansicht/Weltanschauung interpretive distinction is a control, not an invariant lexical law proved here.

rule.label: sensory-affective material negated as material
rule.definition: Sensory and affective content regarded as material to be negated as such while retained formally.
rule.rule: Preserve the qualification as material; the text does not say all sensory contribution simply disappears.

rule.label: mediating synthesis of the word’s contributions
rule.definition: Imagination as the mediating, synthesizing faculty uniting intellectual, sensory, and affective powers in producing or understanding a word.
rule.rule: Distinct from uncontrolled historical speculation by Phantasie or ingenuity.

rule.label: The word’s objective side: how it brings objects of outer and inner perception before the soul in the three stated directions
rule.definition: The word’s objective side: how it brings objects of outer and inner perception before the soul in the three stated directions.
rule.rule: Not simply its acoustic substance.

rule.label: form relative to the matter or material of a particular analysis
rule.definition: The organizing or active side of a locally specified form/matter relation: discourse-connection versus words, the word’s coordinating contribution, or thought’s operations versus objects.
rule.rule: State what counts as matter and form in each source use. In§55 words/discourse-connection is expressly not sounds/rules; the word and thought discussions have different bearers.
rule.caution: These contextual uses must not be flattened into syntax, sound shape, or one independent metaphysical substance.

rule.label: affective tuning
rule.definition: Feeling tuned by language alongside sensory clarity and logical determination.
rule.rule: A broader unconscious intellectual-orientational use is explicitly distinguished on p443.

rule.label: The word’s own motivating conceptual manner of designation, distinguishing expressions for the same object
rule.definition: The word’s own motivating conceptual manner of designation, distinguishing expressions for the same object.
rule.rule: Distinguish historically recoverable motivation from what speakers still feel.

rule.label: sign with independently existing designated content
rule.definition: A sign standing for what can exist independently of it; contrasted with a word whose concept receives completion through it.
rule.rule: A word may serve a sign’s purpose without being reducible to this relation.

rule.label: Symbolic relation in which sensory natural form and nonsensory idea mutually penetrate; its natural form remains independently substantial
rule.definition: Symbolic relation in which sensory natural form and nonsensory idea mutually penetrate; its natural form remains independently substantial.
rule.rule: Keep the later explicit distinction between symbol and word.

rule.label: Mode or duration of dwelling within a sequence of representations, contrasted in symbolizing and linguistic activity
rule.definition: Mode or duration of dwelling within a sequence of representations, contrasted in symbolizing and linguistic activity.
rule.rule: Not simply a measurable interval detached from the cognitive contrast.

rule.label: Affective disposition/power in which feelings and resonances are available, distinguished from intellectual powers while interacting with them
rule.definition: Affective disposition/power in which feelings and resonances are available, distinguished from intellectual powers while interacting with them.
rule.rule: Do not flatten Gemüth into the faculty Verstand.

rule.label: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words
rule.definition: Root word with both grammatical distribution and lexical derivational roles; not necessarily the universal origin of all other words.
rule.rule: Do not force every lexical item under assumed roots.

rule.label: Class of possession/property expressions, later criticized as based on a particular factual relation rather than purely deducible categories
rule.definition: Class of possession/property expressions, later criticized as based on a particular factual relation rather than purely deducible categories.
rule.rule: Retain the historical label; not simply possessive pronoun.

rule.label: unreflective subjective orientation including intellect
rule.definition: Unreflective subjective orientation accompanying word formation and use, expressly broad enough to include purely intellectual direction.
rule.rule: Do not restrict this stipulated broad use to emotion.
